title: Panel Review
description: VERIFY-stage producer artifact. Shared output schema for methodology-reviewer and domain-reviewer, discriminated by `lens`. Each finding requires a non-empty `anchor` (the specific claim/section cited), non-empty `evidence` (proof text), and a `severity` enum. A finding with severity BLOCK means this reviewer blocks synthesis unless explicitly rebutted.

lens.description: discriminator: which reviewer perspective produced this review

findings.description: list of review findings; may be empty if the reviewer finds no issues

anchor.description: non-empty citation of the specific claim, section, figure, or result this finding targets

evidence.description: non-empty explanation of why this is a finding; must cite specific text/numbers, not vague concerns

severity.description: BLOCK means synthesis is refused unless rebutted; WARN is addressable; NOTE is advisory

rebuttal_required.description: true when severity is BLOCK and the synthesizer must document an explicit rebuttal

finding_id.description: optional stable id for cross-referencing in synthesis and response simulation

overall_verdict.description: BLOCK if any finding has severity BLOCK; PASS otherwise. Must be consistent with findings.

reviewer_notes.description: optional free-form notes from the reviewer not captured in individual findings
